discordGate.title: Open in Discord
discordGate.body: This build is a Discord Activity. Launch it from the App Launcher or a server voice channel — not from a regular browser tab.

auth.signInDefault: Connect your Discord account to use this feature.
auth.signInProfile: Connect your Discord account to view your profile and stats.
auth.signInCreate: Connect your Discord account to create, save, and publish events.
auth.signInDiscordCancel: Sign in with Discord to cancel this event.
auth.signInDiscordDelete: Sign in with Discord to delete this draft.
auth.signInDiscordJoin: Sign in with Discord to join this event.
auth.openInDiscordSave: Open this app in Discord to save drafts, join events, and publish.
auth.openInDiscordMyEvents: Open this app in Discord to see events you host or join.
auth.openInDiscordTarget: Open this app in Discord to choose a server and channel.

browse.errorNotConfiguredDesc: Add Supabase URL and anon key to your environment, then reload.

myEvents.emptyList: No events in this list yet

profile.gamertagWarning: Add your Xbox gamertag before joining events on Browse.

participation.leaveLockedAfterStart: You cannot leave after the event has started. Contact the host if you cannot attend.

statusBanner.draftBody: Only you can see this event until you publish it.
statusBanner.inProgressBody: Editing is locked. Submit results when the event is finished, or cancel if it will not run.
statusBanner.registrationClosedBody: This event has started. New players cannot join.
statusBanner.cancelledBody: This event was cancelled by the host.

eventDetail.notFoundDesc: It may have been removed or the link is incorrect.
eventDetail.deleteDraftDesc: Delete this draft permanently? This cannot be undone.
eventDetail.cancelEventDesc: The Discord announcement will be updated and registration will close.

create.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional — e.g. meetup plan, Discord voice channel, what to expect
create.additionalRestrictionsPlaceholder: Optional, e.g. Super Saloons or Modern Muscle
create.publishEventDesc: This posts an announcement in Discord. Server and channel cannot be changed afterward.
create.targetHint: Pick where the event will be announced. You can choose the channel on the final publish step if it is not set yet.
create.supabaseEnvAlert: Add <1>SUPABASE_URL</1> and <3>SUPABASE_ANON_KEY</3> to <5>.env</5>, then restart <7>npm run dev</7>.
create.convoyLeaderHint: In-game Forza lobby leader — can differ from the Discord host.
create.convoyLeaderProfileWarning: Add your Xbox gamertag in Profile before publishing, or enter another convoy leader below.
create.tracksOptionalHint: Optional — add track share codes for the route list.
create.openBuildHint: Open build lets you set a PI cap and optional category notes instead of a fixed car list.

publish.noServers: No servers with the bot yet
publish.noServersHint: Add the bot to a server you manage, then refresh the list.

gamertag.invalid: Use 1–15 letters, numbers, or spaces (Xbox Live rules)
gamertag.modalBody: Enter your Xbox gamertag to join events. It is shown to the host and other players.
gamertag.label: Gamertag
